thought.text: Modelnya jalan, tapi **lambat** — 17–36 detik untuk pertanyaan sederhana. Saya uji ulang untuk konfirmasi.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 400 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess,time
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
for M in ["deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking",
          "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated"]:
    ts=[]
    for i in range(3):
        b=json.dumps({"model":M,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Halo"}],"max_tokens":1000}).encode()
        r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
          headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
        t0=time.time()
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=240) as x: d=json.load(x)
        ts.append(time.time()-t0)
    print(f"{M.split('/')[-1]:52} rata2={sum(ts)/3:.1f}s  ({', '.join(f'{t:.1f}' for t in ts)})")
PY
